desc:
Catch animals with your net, fish up rare pets with your rod and collect 120+ pets with ~25 mutations in this pet catching RNG game!

✨ Halloween Event: Complete Event Tasks to earn Halloween Potions to catch 8 Event Pets!

🎲 Catch Pets → Earn Coins → Upgrade Your Net → Catch Rarer, BIGGER Pets!

⭐ FEATURES
- 12 biomes rotate every 3 minutes, plus special event biomes
- Complete a biome's catch tasks to unlock Fast Travel there anytime
- Every net comes with a matching fishing rod. Fish up sharks, rubber ducks & more
- Hatch eggs in your incubators
- AFK Friendly - your pets earn coins even while you're offline. Come back daily!
- Your pets roam your plot like your own zoo
- Trade pets with friends

🍀 HOW TO CATCH
1. Walk into a biome
2. Swing your net near an animal
3. Hit the skill check for extra luck (or use Auto Catch)
4. Every catch is RNG: will it be Mutated and BIG?!

❤️ Egg available for claim every 250 Likes!
